answer: Give each newcomer a live navigational exam, not a free ledger name. Each epoch the network opens a narrow inlet and assigns the applicant a random jetty: an address-salted, interactive channel with rotating miners whose next probe depends on the prior reply and cannot be precomputed. The applicant must keep that watch alive for a full window, then may drop a later-withdrawable stake as their anchor. One operator cannot hold many concurrent watches, and reused reply trees sink every linked berth.
